name: Floor Powder

ad.headline: Remove Grime
ad.description: A heavy-duty cleaning powder that dissolves, loosens, and suspends heavy embedded soils and allows them to be rinsed away. Dissolves completely in water and will not leave a powdery residue. Use anywhere concrete or a hard surface should be cleaned.
benefits: Powder formula quickly penetrates grease and oil.
Removes dirt and grime from garage and shop floors.
Dissolves quickly in water and will not leave a powdery residue.
